title: People’s Mañanera November 23
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Mexican Government Honors Fallen Soldiers and Reaffirms Strategy to Bring
Peace to Sinaloa  
** President Claudia Sheinbaum acknowledged the work of the Army and the
National Guard in capturing drug kingpin El Chapo Isidro in Guasave. She paid
tribute to the four fallen soldiers, instructed officials to support their
families, and wished the 10 wounded a speedy recovery. Sheinbaum noted that
the decline in intentional homicides nationwide is the most visible result of
the National Security Strategy.

**Mexico and China Join Forces to Promote a Smart Hospital  
** The Mexican government is evaluating which hospital could be converted into
a smart hospital. The cooperation with China includes technology and training
for healthcare personnel.

**Rosario Castellanos University to Open in Zacatecas with 2,000 Students  
** Classes will begin in April, and construction will continue until the
campus can accommodate 10,000 students by the end of 2028. The campus will
offer programs in medicine and nursing, and the Gertrudis Bocanegra
scholarships will expand access to the university.
